from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReportData(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric extracted from one document's annual report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by this report, e.g. '2021'")
    net_result_amount: float | None = Field(description="The net income or loss amount; negative for loss, positive for income")
    result_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the report for this figure, e.g. 'Net loss', 'Net income'")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial statements, e.g. 'USD'")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document, e.g. 'Form 10-K'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReportData]
